name: Bounded Researcher-to-Library proposal transfer
description: Runnable, pinned Python 3.12 source bundle for idempotent bounded transfer of actual Researcher SQLite proposals into a Library planning queue; preserves duplicate detection, schema checks, and read-only source DB semantics.

security.notes: Pending independent security and license review. Sandbox-only. No claim of production certification.

integration.adapter_notes: Python source tools from immutable Library commit, including original negative/idempotency unit tests. The transfer CLI requires an explicit trusted Researcher checkout, its existing read-only SQLite DB, and a caller-controlled Library planning queue directory; it never approves/certifies or publishes a module.
known_constraints: No authentication, GitHub PR creation, or remote repository writing in module
Read-only Researcher SQLite access but local Library planning queue writes by design
No execution of candidate code or automatic security certification
Linux Python 3.12 tests passed (11/11); Android, Windows and live cross-repo delivery not validated
No independent production security or redistribution license sign-off
